source.title: GORGO: Online Tuning for Cross-Region Network-Aware LLM Serving
source.summary: Proposes GORGO, a proxy for geo-distributed LLM inference that holistically balances network latency, prefill cost, and queueing delay to reduce uneven KV-cache concentration across cross-region replicas, reporting 6.9-15.5% p95 TTFT improvements. Revised through July 2026.
